answers.drew: Started as an actress, dipped toes into Production through HS/University. Fell in love with development & production as much as acting!
answers.seeking: I am looking to connect with students of the world! No matter their age or experience, I want to learn from creatives that can expand my knowledge of the world and of the industry.
answers.inspiration: My current biggest inspiration is Reese Witherspoon. Her brand is INSANE and she is badass with her bookclub & producing her favorite ones!
